Declarations.Name: Winner
Declarations.Tooltip: The posture decision's current winner (written by the one ScoreDecision in the Sense task's While Running chain).

EditorMetadata.Description: CE-3083 G5 — the CombatPosture decision as a blueprint: one ScoreDecision (in the Sense task's While Running) writes Winner; a dispatcher starts the winner's Behaviour Task; each task aborts itself when Winner leaves its option. docs/DESIGN_Decision_Layer.md §3.3d.
